title: Mugavaree
desc: Sridhar, an aspiring music director, has been struggling to get a foothold in the music industry for many years. He falls in love but is willing to put his relationship on a back burner for success.

title: Kathavarayan
desc: Kathavarayan, an illegal liquor dealer, faces trouble when a student, who vows to expose those who flout the laws, gets him arrested.

title: Manmadhan
desc: Mythili meets Madhan and feels instantly drawn towards him. However, she is gripped by fear when she realises that he eerily resembles a serial killer from her recurring nightmare.

title: Kaalamellam Kaathal Vaazhga
desc: A mutual passion for music attracts Kausalya and Jeeva to each other, via phone calls. Over time, their connection grows stronger, and their frequent conversations spark a love story between them.

title: Azhagu Raja
desc: Azhagu Raja, who owns a cable channel, always mocks Priya, who fails at everything. Eventually, love blossoms between them, but their families' bitter past becomes an obstacle to their marriage.
